title: Pocketwire Visa Debit Card Terms: Tenure Courtesy on Takeover-Card Credits
content:
**Cardholder terms: tenure courtesy, Pocketwire Visa Debit Card.**

**1.** On a dispute of a purchase on a *takeover card*, a virtual card the cardholder says they never created, the tenure courtesy depends on how many whole months the linked Pocketwire Personal Account has been open on the filing date.

**2.** The tenure courtesy is:
- (a) 10.00, when the linked personal account has been open 60 or more whole months;
- (b) 5.00, when it has been open 24 or more, but fewer than 60, whole months;
- (c) 0.00, when it has been open fewer than 24 whole months.

**3.** The months are counted from the opening (sign-up) date recorded on the Pocketwire Personal Account to the filing date, and only whole months count.

### Band edges (hypothetical account ages)

| Whole months open on the filing date | Tenure courtesy |
|---|---|
| 62 | 10.00 |
| 60 | 10.00, because 60 is "60 or more" |
| 59 | 5.00 |
| 36 | 5.00 |
| 24 | 5.00, because 24 is "24 or more" |
| 23 | 0.00 |
| 18 | 0.00 |
